jobs.title: Product Operations Associate
jobs.why: Exceptional product-operations match with a low experience barrier: process operations, identifying user patterns, partnering with Engineering on features and bugs, consumer experience, analytics, and solving ambiguous operational problems.
jobs.gap: The role is fully in-person five days a week in NYC and startup-paced; Audrey should be comfortable with that working model and emphasize ownership and measurable process improvements.

jobs.title: Product Operations Senior Associate
jobs.why: Strong bridge between Audrey's systems/operations experience and Product Ops: translating user feedback into requirements, investigating product issues, collaborating with Product and Engineering, and using data to improve workflows.
jobs.gap: The role expects 2-4+ years in product operations or an adjacent analytical environment and comfort learning SQL, so Audrey should foreground her closest product-adjacent work and analytical examples.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Test Kit)
jobs.why: Excellent operations fit centered on launches, implementation, workflow ownership, customer coordination, dashboards, metrics, root-cause problem solving, documentation, and process improvement in healthcare technology.
jobs.gap: Junction asks for 3+ years in operations or adjacent work and values healthcare/logistics exposure; Audrey should explicitly map her implementation and cross-functional experience to customer launches and operational ownership.

jobs.title: Product Designer I
jobs.location: Hybrid NYC (3 days/week) or Remote in Eastern Time
jobs.why: One of the strongest realistic UX transition roles: it is designed for candidates with limited professional experience and focuses on Figma, high-fidelity UI, design systems, product/engineering collaboration, research support, data-informed decisions, and B2B healthcare software.
jobs.gap: Audrey needs a polished portfolio demonstrating high-craft UI and strong Figma fundamentals; the posting expects roughly 1-2 years of professional experience plus broader UI practice.

jobs.title: Product Operations Associate
jobs.why: High-upside Product Ops opportunity in a product and engineering organization. Audrey's systems, cross-functional delivery, process improvement, and operations background create a credible bridge into this track.
jobs.gap: The compensation and fintech environment imply a competitive bar; Audrey should emphasize product-adjacent ownership, analytical decision-making, and concrete operational impact.
